name: forms.app Free
free_limit: Up to 5 hosted forms with unlimited submissions, responses, questions, views and team members, plus 10 MB total file storage on the free-forever plan.
watch_out: 10 MB of file storage can limit upload-heavy use, and more forms, branding removal and custom subdomains require paid plans. No credit card is required on Free. Any payment-processing or integration fees are separate; commercial-use policy needs confirmation.
